question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word:PERSUASIVE
solution: The correct answer is: **Compelling**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"Persuasive"** means convincing or able to influence someone to do or believe something through reasoning or argument. (प्रभावशाली, मनाने वाला) • **Example: **Her persuasive speech convinced the audience to support her cause. • **"Compelling" **refers to something that evokes interest, attention, or admiration in a powerful and irresistible way; it can also mean forceful and convincing. (प्रभावशाली, मजबूर करने वाला) • **Example: **The documentary presented compelling evidence that changed public opinion on the issue. • Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Persuasive' **is **'Compelling'**. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Compelling**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Doubtful **(संदेहपूर्ण): Feeling uncertain or having doubts about something. • **Example:** He was doubtful about the success of the new project. • **Vague **(अस्पष्ट ): Not clearly expressed, defined, or understood. • **Example: **Her explanation was so vague that no one could understand the main point. • **Fragile** (नाजुक): Easily broken, damaged, or destroyed. • **Example:** The glass vase is very fragile, so handle it with care. 34:T9b1, The correct answer is: **Energy**.
